title: {Syn} BERT Made Bidirectional Pretraining Mainstream
content:
BERT used masked-language-model pretraining to learn bidirectional text representations. Instead of predicting only the next token, it learned from hidden tokens inside a sentence.

The model improved many NLP benchmarks and helped establish pretrain-then-finetune as a dominant workflow.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
